##### Project general facts

Elie Saab A Vie is an exclusive gated collection of townhouses where the world-renowned fashion icon Elie Saab has breathed life into every home. Modern architectural details blend naturally into a splendid community setting, creating an urban oasis for families who are seeking peaceful serenity and a truly superior standard of living. Available as middle and end units with their own private gardens and pools, each townhouse is a standalone masterpiece, tastefully designed for living.

Residents enjoy a connected and integrated lifestyle, with a wonderful mix of amenities and activities that make the transition between work, life and play completely seamless. Four dedicated zones offer a multitude of experiences: areas for yoga, barbecues, jogging, a kids park and generous lounging spaces, a tennis court, a swimming pool for both adults and children, and a serenity park for quiet retreats and moments of contemplation. The community adds even more delight with a club house offering a gym, wellness centre, yoga area, indoor and outdoor kids play areas, a residents lounge, a children's party hall and an outdoor gardening area, plus a community mall with over forty retail outlets including a mini mart, chemist, florist, coffee shop, juice bar, salons, a health centre and a pet shop.

Inside, attention to detail is simply unparalleled, from harmonious colours and noble textures to the carefully selected cabinet handles and hardware. Elegant living and dining spaces open seamlessly onto the garden through full-height glazing, while sleek contemporary kitchens with beautifully integrated appliances, refined joinery and generous islands make everyday life a pleasure. Sumptuous marble surfaces, warm brass accents, sculptural lighting and a soft, luminous palette give the master bedroom and bathrooms an air of absolute comfort and flawless finishing.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan City is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, it offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan City have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
